name: Ripio wCLP
oneLiner: WCLP is Ripio's wrapped Chilean peso stablecoin targeting 1 WCLP = 1 CLP, backed by CLP cash and local-currency instruments under Ripio's wFIAT issuance.
collateral: Chilean-peso cash and liquid local-currency instruments backing Ripio wCLP at a one Chilean peso target
pegMechanism: WCLP is issued and managed by Ripio against local fiat reserves, but ordinary holders do not have a documented direct redemption right with the issuer. Exits depend on secondary-market liquidity, Ripio on/off-ramp flows, or issuer-managed market operations.

mintAuthority.summary: WCLP is an issuer-managed Ripio wFIAT token. All chains use the same contract address with identical role holders: EOA 0x466c02e2 (DEFAULT_ADMIN + MINTER), Safe 0x2b839174 (4/7, DEFAULT_ADMIN), and two AccessControl minter-router contracts whose own admins are the same EOA and Safe.

upgradeability.controlRef: Ripio shared WCLP admin and MINTER_ROLE holder (EOA)

controls.label: Ripio shared WCLP admin and MINTER_ROLE holder (EOA)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295015, hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE) and hasRole(MINTER_ROLE) both returned true. eth_getCode returned 0x (EOA). Same role confirmed via hasRole on Base, BSC, Polygon, Gnosis, and Worldchain at same block range.

controls.label: Ripio WCLP Safe multisig (DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295015, hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE) returned true. getOwners() returned 7 owners; getThreshold() returned 4. getModulesPaginated returned empty array (no modules). slot0 masterCopy = 0x41675c...61a (Safe v1.4.1 singleton). fallbackHandler = 0xfd0732...ec99 (standard CompatibilityFallbackHandler). getGuard() reverted (no guard).

controls.label: Ripio WCLP Ethereum minter-router contract
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295015, hasRole(MINTER_ROLE) returned true on WCLP token. Contract is an AccessControl contract with DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE holders confirmed as 0x466c02e2 (EOA) and 0x2b839174 (Safe). Not deployed on other chains (eth_getCode = 0x on Base).

controls.label: Ripio WCLP cross-chain minter-router contract
controls.evidence: At block 25295015, hasRole(MINTER_ROLE) returned true on WCLP token on Ethereum, Base, BSC, Polygon, and Gnosis. Contract is an AccessControl contract with DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE holders confirmed as 0x466c02e2 (EOA) and 0x2b839174 (Safe).

review.evidence: All mint-capable role holders verified via hasRole() across Ethereum, Base, BSC, Polygon, Gnosis, and Worldchain at block 25295015. EOA 0x466c02e2 confirmed via eth_getCode. Safe 0x2b839174 confirmed as 4/7 Safe v1.4.1 with no modules or guard. Minter-router contracts 0xd168cfbb and 0x46167cb0 confirmed as AccessControl contracts whose admins are the same EOA and Safe.

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Re-verified 2026-07-30. The Sourcify exact-match LatamStable implementation 0x8898786f1e1e9ed77def940a2ecb7cf07af8d6ba (source re-opened 2026-07-30) inherits ERC20PausableUpgradeable with _update gated whenNotPaused, so a live PAUSER_ROLE can halt every holder transfer globally; it exposes no per-address blacklist, freeze, or seize mapping. All six deployments share this implementation: the Ethereum and Base proxy EIP-1967 implementation slots re-read at Ethereum block 25656501 and Base block 49328608 both resolve to it, and the 2026-07-20 deployment-scoped transfer review verified code-hash identity on worldchain, bsc, polygon, and gnosis. Role history from RoleGranted/RoleRevoked logs on Ethereum: deployer 0x5ca3f8eeba12d83408fc097c2dad79212456f20f held all roles from initialization (block 23891029) and was fully revoked at block 24995207, when DEFAULT_ADMIN, PAUSER, MINTER, and UPGRADER all moved to Ripio EOA 0x466c02e2cc67b81a696af5afdb61605c41fe247b. Fixed-block reads confirm hasRole(PAUSER_ROLE, that EOA) = true and paused() = false at Ethereum block 25656501 and Base block 49328608; UPGRADER_ROLE (UUPS, no timelock) is held by the same EOA, with the 4-of-7 Safe 0x2b839174fe62466067c22e2a4c8054071f9d8d68 as second DEFAULT_ADMIN. Reach is a token-level global pause controlled by a single EOA, not a per-address blacklist, and transfers are currently open; true reflects that live pause capability (same verdict basis as the dusd-dtrinity 2026-07-30 review). No wrapper or bridge inheritance applies - issuance is issuer-native burn-mint on every chain.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: WCLP is issuer-minted on all six deployments by Ripio's own minter-router contracts (cross-chain router 0x46167cB0... holds MINTER_ROLE on every chain, verified on-chain), with the 4-of-7 Ripio Safe as DEFAULT_ADMIN. No third-party bridge carries the claim; cross-chain movement is issuer-operated burn-mint.

reserves.name: Chilean-peso cash and local-currency liquid instruments
reserves.issuerOrObligor: Undisclosed Chilean financial institution(s) and Ripio wFIAT issuer

reserveReview.reviewer: OpenAI Codex backing review; Kimi T24 re-verification
reserveReview.rationale: Ripio's current local-stablecoin page identifies WCLP as a Chilean-peso stablecoin in its wFIAT product family. Re-checked 2026-07-30: the wFIAT attestation index publishes CPA certifications for wARS (December 2025 and March 2026), wBRL, wCOP, and wMXN as of 2026-03-31, but still no wCLP attestation or reserve report, so the composition stays unclassified rather than borrowing sibling-token assurance. The repository's existing collateral description supports a single aggregate reserve envelope of Chilean-peso cash and liquid local-currency instruments, but the reviewed issuer page does not publish a WCLP-specific asset split, named financial institution, or reserve attestation.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Ripio wFIAT local-stablecoin disclosure for WCLP
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The full 100% reserve envelope remains unclassified beyond Chilean-peso cash and liquid local-currency instruments; no per-token attestation or current category weights were found.

nonLinkDispositions.reserveName: Chilean-peso cash and local-currency liquid instruments
nonLinkDispositions.rationale: Ripio identifies the wFIAT reserve family but does not publish WCLP-specific category weights, counterparties, or an assurance report.

providers.name: Ripio wFIAT issuer and onchain token contracts

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Ripio does not name WCLP reserve institutions, account structure, legal segregation, bankruptcy treatment, or rehypothecation terms on the reviewed product page. Ordinary holders also lack a documented direct issuer redemption right in the existing token metadata.

notices.title: Peg grouped as Other
notices.message: CLP is not yet a first-class Pharos peg-currency enum, so WCLP is grouped under OTHER while the DefiLlama price and circulating-supply path admits the asset at runtime.

notices.title: No per-token attestation located
notices.message: Ripio describes wFIAT local-currency backing, but no reliable public per-token reserve attestation was found for WCLP during this addition. Curated reserves remain conservative until source coverage improves.
